<p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><b>ORLANDO, FL.</b> &#8211; August 14, 2026&nbsp;&#8211; The LGL Group, Inc. (NYSE American: LGL) ("LGL," "LGL Group," or the "Company") announced today its financial results for the second quarter ended <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="559053" data-tblv="62" id="led559053F20266161784216092824">June 30, 2026</a>.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">"This quarter's revenue growth and record backlog reflect strong underlying demand for the mission-critical timing and synchronization technology our platforms provide," said Jason Lamb, LGL Group Chief Executive Officer. "We are encouraged by the trajectory of our aerospace and defense and commercial applications and remain focused on translating this momentum into sustained long-term growth and stockholder value creation."</p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><b>Consolidated Results</b></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 6pt; text-indent: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><i><b><a data-tblloc="44x1" data-tblname="559053" data-tblv="62" id="led559053F20244131715629544169">Second</a>&nbsp;Quarter&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="559053" data-tblv="62" id="led559053F20244131715626886605">2026</a>&nbsp;</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><i>Total revenues</i> were&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20267131786641768367">$1,153,000</a> for the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="20x1" data-tblname="559054" data-tblv="62" id="led559054F20244131715627754024">three months ended June 30, 2026</a>&nbsp;compared to&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x2" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20267131786641774549">$924,000</a>&nbsp;for the <a data-tblloc="21x1" data-tblname="559054" data-tblv="62" id="led559054F20244131715630570668">three months ended June 30, 2025</a>. The&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x5" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20267131786641780132">increase</a> was&nbsp;primarily due to the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x3" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20267131786645011535">$259,000</a> increase in Net sales within our Electronic Instruments segment&nbsp;due to higher product shipments as orders in backlog as&nbsp;of March 31, 2026 converted to revenue partially offset by the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="3x3" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20267131786645021986">$16,000</a> decrease in Net investment income driven by lower yields on investments in United States&nbsp;Treasury money market funds and the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x3" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20267131786645099801">$14,000</a> decrease in Net gains (losses) driven by lower mark-to-market movements on Marketable securities.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><i>Gross margin</i> was&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="17x1" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20246311722451707233">49.2%</a>&nbsp;for the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="20x1" data-tblname="559054" data-tblv="62" id="led559054F20244131715627754024">three months ended June 30, 2026</a>&nbsp;compared to&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="17x2" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20246311722451715984">57.0%</a>&nbsp;for the <a data-tblloc="21x1" data-tblname="559054" data-tblv="62" id="led559054F20244131715630570668">three months ended June 30, 2025</a>. The decrease was&nbsp;primarily due to changes in product and pricing mix associated with volume-based pricing extended to a single customer in connection with increased order volume partially offset by the increase in Net sales discussed above.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><i>Net loss attributable&nbsp;to LGL Group common stockholders</i> was <a data-tblloc="15x1" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20246311722451343260">($353,000)</a>,&nbsp;or&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="20x1" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20246311722451357808">($0.06)</a>&nbsp;per diluted share, compared with <a data-tblloc="15x2" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20246311722451401439">($51,000)</a>, or&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="20x2" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20246311722451410428">($0.01)</a>&nbsp;per diluted share, in the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="559053" data-tblv="62" id="led559053F20244131715630407893">second</a>&nbsp;quarter of <a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="559053" data-tblv="62" id="led559053F20247131723559858028">2025</a>.&nbsp;The&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="15x5" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20246311722451432796">decrease</a>&nbsp;was primarily due to higher Engineering, selling, and administrative expenses driven by&nbsp;a $143,000 increase in&nbsp;stock-based compensation, a $100,000 increase in professional service fees, a $37,000 increase in&nbsp;salaries and wages and related benefits, and a $78,000 increase in other corporate expenses&nbsp;partially offset by higher Net sales&nbsp;discussed above.</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 6pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0pt;"><i><b>Fiscal Year to Date&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="559053" data-tblv="62" id="led559053F20244131715627225308">2026</a></b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0pt;"><i>Total revenues</i> were&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x7" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20267131786641829004">$2,238,000</a> for the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="559054" data-tblv="62" id="led559054F20244131715630593346">six months ended June 30, 2026</a>&nbsp;compared to&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x8" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20267131786641842495">$1,842,000</a> for the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="14x1" data-tblname="559054" data-tblv="62" id="led559054F20266301785429107350">six months ended June 30, 2025</a>.&nbsp;The&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x11" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20267131786641855647">increase</a> was primarily due to&nbsp;the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x9" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20267131786645043581">$443,000</a> increase in Net sales within our Electronic Instruments segment&nbsp;due to higher product shipments as orders in backlog converted to revenue partially offset by the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="3x9" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20267131786645056334">$44,000</a> decrease in Net investment income driven by lower yields on investments in United States&nbsp;Treasury money market funds.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><i>Gross margin</i> was&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="17x7" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20246311722452460672">50.1%</a>&nbsp;for the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="559054" data-tblv="62" id="led559054F20244131715630593346">six months ended June 30, 2026</a>&nbsp;compared to&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="17x8" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20266301785429087571">54.7%</a>&nbsp;for the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="14x1" data-tblname="559054" data-tblv="62" id="led559054F20266301785429107350">six months ended June 30, 2025</a>. The decrease was primarily due to changes in product and pricing mix associated volume-based pricing extended to a single customer in connection with increased order volume partially offset by the increase in Net sales discussed above.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><i>Net loss attributable&nbsp;to LGL group common stockholders</i> was <a data-tblloc="15x7" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20246311722451801479">($975,000)</a>, or <a data-tblloc="20x7" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20246311722451812904">($0.15)</a>&nbsp;per diluted share, compared with <a data-tblloc="15x8" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20246311722451822559">($57,000)</a>, or <a data-tblloc="20x8" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F20246311722451831842">($0.01)</a>&nbsp;per diluted share, in&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="559053" data-tblv="62" id="led559053F20244131715630477997">2025</a>. The increase&nbsp;was primarily due to&nbsp;higher Engineering, selling, and administrative expenses driven by $822,000 higher stock-based compensation related&nbsp;to grants made to key employees in January and May 2026, a $300,000 increase in professional service fees, a $85,000 increase in salaries and wages and related benefits, and a $100,000 increase in other corporate expenses partially offset by higher Net sales due to higher product shipments as orders in backlog converted to revenue.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><i>Cash and cash equivalents and marketable securities</i> were <a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="559131" data-tblv="62" id="led559131F20266301785427738103" originalfact="$45,156,000" scale-include-commas="true" scale-precision="1" scale-round="true" scale-show-unit="true" scale-unit="1000000">$45.2 million</a>&nbsp;as of <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="559053" data-tblv="62" id="led559053F20266161784217786629">June 30, 2026</a> compared to <a data-tblloc="2x2" data-tblname="559131" data-tblv="62" id="led559131F20266301785427745572" originalfact="$41,550,000" scale-include-commas="true" scale-precision="1" scale-round="true" scale-show-unit="true" scale-unit="1000000">$41.6 million</a>&nbsp;as of <a data-tblloc="25x1" data-tblname="559053" data-tblv="62" id="led559053F20266161784217804051">December 31, 2025</a>. The increase was primarily due to $4.6 million of net&nbsp;proceeds from the warrant dividend program completed in January 2026 and $1.2 million in capital contributions from non-controlling interests into&nbsp;Skyline Instruments May 2026, a Series of CGF2021 LLC partially offset by the $2.0 million&nbsp;investment in the convertible promissory note issued by Skyline Instruments Corporation.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><i>Book value attributable to LGL Group common stockholders</i> was&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x5" data-tblname="559131" data-tblv="62" id="led559131F20267131786642248437">$6.77</a> as of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="559053" data-tblv="62" id="led559053F20267131786641641365">June 30, 2026</a> compared to&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x6" data-tblname="559131" data-tblv="62" id="led559131F20267131786642253484">$7.04</a> as of <a data-tblloc="25x1" data-tblname="559053" data-tblv="62" id="led559053F20267131786641664675">December 31, 2025</a>. The decrease&nbsp;was primarily due to the net loss attributable to LGL Group common stockholders discussed above, the increase in shares outstanding resulting from restricted stock grants to key employees in January and May 2026&nbsp;for which a portion vested immediately, and&nbsp;the increase in shares outstanding related to the warrant program completed in January 2026, pursuant to which shares were issued at an exercise price of $4.75 per share.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0pt;"><i><b>Backlog</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><a data-tblloc="8x1" data-tblname="559053" data-tblv="62" id="led559053F20244131715629530538">As of June 30, 2026</a>, our order backlog was <a data-tblloc="21x7" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F2024711722532008637">$3,628,000</a>,&nbsp;an&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="21x11" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F2024711722532016447">increase</a>&nbsp;of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="21x9" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F2024711722532025022">$3,003,000</a>&nbsp;from&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="21x8" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F2024711722532034609">$625,000</a>&nbsp;as of <a data-tblloc="25x1" data-tblname="559053" data-tblv="62" id="led559053F2024711722532062366">December 31, 2025</a>&nbsp;and an&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="21x5" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F2024761722949857353">increase</a> of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="21x3" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F2024761722949862915">$3,101,000</a> from&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="21x2" data-tblname="559129" data-tblv="62" id="led559129F2024761722949869199">$527,000</a> as of <a data-tblloc="6x1" data-tblname="559054" data-tblv="62" id="led559054F2024761722949758815">June 30, 2025</a>. The backlog of unfilled orders includes amounts based on signed contracts, which we have determined are firm orders likely to be fulfilled primarily in the next 12 months but most of the backlog will ship in the next 90 days. Additionally, we announced a series of orders totaling $6.0 million from a customer in August 2026, of which $3.4 million was included in our backlog as of June 30, 2026.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Warrant Dividend Program</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">In January 2026, LGL Group completed its warrant dividend program, generating&nbsp;approximately $5.0 million in gross proceeds. The warrants were distributed on November 16, 2020 and expired on December 31, 2025. The Company issued&nbsp;1,051,664 shares of common stock, par value $0.01 (the "Common Stock"), representing 100% of the shares issuable</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Rights Offering</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">In July 2026, LGL Group completed a transferable subscription rights offering (the "Rights Offering") generating roughly $41.8 million, increasing cash and cash equivalents and marketable securities to over $86.0 million. The Rights Offering commenced on June 8, 2026 and expired at 5:00 p.m., Eastern time, on Wednesday, July 15, 2026. The Company issued 6,062,714 shares of Common Stock, representing approximately 92.6% of the 6,550,435 shares offered in the Rights Offering. After giving effect to the shares sold in the Rights Offering, the Company currently has approximately 12.6 million shares of Common Stock outstanding.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">Marc Gabelli, Executive Chairman of LGL Group, purchased&nbsp;3,331,675 shares, increasing his total share ownership to 4,387,727 shares.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 3pt; text-indent: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><b>About The LGL Group, Inc.</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">The LGL Group, Inc. ("LGL," "LGL Group," or the "Company") is a holding company engaged in services, merchant investment and manufacturing business activities. Precise Time and Frequency, LLC ("PTF") is a globally positioned producer of industrial Electronic Instruments and commercial products and services. Founded in 2002, PTF operates from our design and manufacturing facility in Wakefield, Massachusetts. Lynch Capital International LLC is focused on the development of value through investments.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">LGL Group was incorporated in 1928 under the laws of the State of Indiana, and in 2007, the Company was reincorporated under the laws of the State of Delaware as The LGL Group, Inc. We maintain our executive offices at 2525 Shader Road, Orlando, Florida 32804. Our telephone number is (202) 780-5941. Our Internet address is www.lglgroup.com. LGL Group common stock is traded on the NYSE American ("NYSE") under the symbol&nbsp;"LGL."</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">LGL Group's business strategy is primarily focused on growth through expanding new and existing operations across diversified industries. The Company's engineering and design origins date back to the early 1900s. In 1917, Lynch Glass Machinery Company ("Lynch Glass"), the predecessor of LGL Group, was formed and emerged in the late 1920s as a successful manufacturer of glass-forming machinery. Lynch Glass&nbsp;was then renamed Lynch Corporation ("Lynch") and was incorporated in 1928 under the laws of the State of Indiana. In 1946, Lynch was listed on the "New York Curb Exchange," the predecessor to the NYSE American. The Company has a had a long history of owning and operating various business in the precision engineering, manufacturing, and services sectors.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b>Cautionary Note&nbsp;Concerning Forward-Looking Statements</b></p>
